_about: Pell's emotion tags -> face blendshape weights (docs/kb/art/characters/pell.md §6.2), on the Kirru muzzle (the shared 40-shape API through pell_head.kirru_warp). A pair is [L, R]; a scalar sets both sides of a paired shape. His tell: the crest speaks before the face does; each row carries the crest (`crest_raise` 0-1 on the Crest mesh, `crest_flat` for grief), which the stage applies with the face; the face itself moves very little, the whiskers following cheek_raise forward and mouth_frown down. The smile rises on the right first (R = L x 1.15). He hums, never cries out: no row opens the mouth past jaw_open 0.10, and lip_upper_up (bared teeth) is never used. No tear layer (pell.md §12 Q6, carried). Blend 0.36 s, measured, no overshoot, starting 0.25 s after the line or the cut (`onset_delay_s`, a per-actor setting requested from Cinematics with the crest column). Tags: game/data/dialogue/emotions.json. Read by the hero stage for the M3-CHR-506 review shots; the sequencer.json face_poses entry is Cinematics'.

head_notes.neutral: still, attentive; most of Act I
head_notes.laugh: a soft huff, the mouth nearly closed; the head dips 6 degrees (a clip or gesture, not the face)
head_notes.sad: the whiskers droop through the frown
head_notes.grief: reserved: Ch11 before Nhoa, the dive; no tear layer
head_notes.angry: the crest up hard and the muzzle wrinkled; the mouth stays closed; rare
head_notes.surprised: the crest does most of it
head_notes.guilty: Ch9 B09, the blank shell; gaze down 10 degrees
head_notes.exhausted: the neck lowers 6 degrees (a clip, not the face)
